C0143.title: Resale of a Game Account and Subsequent Recovery Leads to Theft Conviction
C0143.summary: In October 2022, a trial court convicted a player of theft after he sold a game account and then recovered it through an appeal process, sentencing him to three years and six months in prison and a 50,000-yuan fine. Shanghai No. 2 Intermediate People's Court rejected the appeal and upheld the original judgment. The case clarified that game accounts are legally protected virtual property and that recovering and illegally occupying a sold account is unlawful.
